c74object.name: evi.randy~
c74object.digest: Cubic interpolated version of the linear MSP rand~
c74object.description:
evi.randy~ is a 'max define' for the evi_randy.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.randy~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
Being cubic interpolated the spectrum of this random oscillator rolls off much more steeply than the output of rand~, which may or may not be useful. At LFO frequencies this is a really useful smooth control source. @see: 'evi_sources.genexpr' and 'evi_lfo.genexpr' for more like this.

inlet.description: Frequency at which to sample new values internally, controlling the speed of the segments.

outlet.digest: Outlet #1: Cubic Interpolated Rand~like Noise Output

outlet.description: The white noise source used to create rand output.
